# Aroha

> Aroha is an open protocol (Apache-2.0) for bounded, verifiable agent authority: a person signs a mandate, each agent can pass on only a narrower one, a tool verifies the chain offline before acting, revocation reaches every verifier, and every allowed or refused action leaves a signed receipt. It works with MCP, A2A and existing identity providers; it is not an agent framework, a transport or an IdP.

To add Aroha to an existing agent, follow the `aroha-integrate` Agent Skill: wrap an MCP server with `@aroha-sdk/mcp-guard` (config only), verify mandates in a handler with `verifyMandateChain`, present a mandate over MCP in `_meta["aroha/mandate"]` with `presentMandate`, or run the Aroha runtime. Prove each refusal case fails closed. Repository versions are ahead of npm/PyPI; check the support matrix before pinning.

## Start here

- [What Aroha is (and is not)](positioning.md): scope, the four questions, market fit

## Agent Skills (SKILL.md, load into any Agent Skills host)

- [aroha-integrate](https://github.com/ArohaLabs/aroha-protocol/blob/main/skills/aroha-integrate/SKILL.md): add Aroha to an existing agent; start here
- [aroha-mandates](https://github.com/ArohaLabs/aroha-protocol/blob/main/skills/aroha-mandates/SKILL.md): issue, attenuate and verify spending and task mandates
- [aroha-receipts](https://github.com/ArohaLabs/aroha-protocol/blob/main/skills/aroha-receipts/SKILL.md): sign and verify action receipts for executed and denied actions
- [aroha-python-sdk](https://github.com/ArohaLabs/aroha-protocol/blob/main/skills/aroha-python-sdk/SKILL.md): verification from Python
